summary: Manual GO-LIVE test pack for the Saranam India Health Care Patient Management module. Covers the patient list, quick-add registration, patient detail dashboard (Overview, Visits, Trends, Past Records tabs), patient edit, all baseline clinical assessment forms (Nursing, Doctor, Psychological, Physiotherapy, ESAS-R, PPS, Plan of Care), the body-map editor, AI/follow-up summaries, care circle, universal PPS, UHID generation/regeneration, mark-deceased, and every backend API endpoint exposed by app/patients/routes.py. Includes happy paths, validations, negative/error paths, empty & loading states, permission/session handling, and cross-module data integrity.
in_scope: Patient list screen: load, search, BSC/Onco/Zone filters, clear filters, grid/table view toggle, pagination, Add New Patient, row click navigation, empty & loading states

Patient registration (PatientQuickAdd dialog): required + optional fields, +91 phone handling, approximate age, Bangalore zone auto-suggest from PIN, GPS/map location capture + zone detection, linked hospital selection + inline add, diagnosis/referral inline add, ABHA duplicate check, patient category & priority, success/UHID messaging

Patient detail dashboard: header chips (status, UHID copy, homecare code, zone, priority), scheduling strip (edit frequency/priority/notes, flag/unflag urgent), admin UHID regeneration, tab navigation

Overview tab: demographics, clinical status chips, body map editor (free-click markers + AI highlights), universal PPS card, care circle card, follow-up summary history, AI patient summary (generate/save/download), baseline assessment accordions, patient category & priority save, UHID preview + Mark Initial Assessment Complete (UHID assignment)
Baseline assessment forms: Nursing, Doctor, Psychological, Physiotherapy, ESAS-R, PPS, Plan of Care (save, reload, AI summaries, validations, score bounds)

Visits tab: list visits, create visit (follow-up/emergency/initial/teleconsult), vitals capture, teleconsult provider+time+record-call, visit detail follow-up sheet, save & mark complete, patient outcome / mark deceased from visit
Trends tab: vitals/ESAS-R/PPS charts, source legend, vital tab selector, symptom toggles, baseline comparison, empty state
Past Records tab: full-history timeline, type filter chips, expand/collapse events, empty state

Patient edit screen: all demographic/clinical/location/status fields, phone +91 normalisation, Bangalore resident toggle, linked hospital + inline add, mark deceased / edit death record, save + redirect
Mark Deceased dialog (shared): date/place/remarks validation, edit mode, care-status auto-demotion, scheduling-pool removal

Backend API: GET/POST/PUT patients, search, duplicate-check, recent, timeline, submissions, full-history, zones detect/boundaries, UHID preview/regenerate, patient PPS, config (diagnosis-options, referral-partners, hospital-options)
Auth/session: token attach, 401 refresh-and-retry, refresh failure redirect to /login, route guards for /patients, /patients/:id, /patients/:id/edit
out_of_scope: Saranam scheduling pool / day-map screens beyond the patient-detail scheduling strip
Teleconsult session UI/video room (only the teleconsult scheduling trigger from the Visits tab is in scope)
OPD / IPD / Encounters / Inventory dispensing modules (only their read-only appearance in the Past Records timeline is in scope)
Authentication/login screen internals (login flow itself is a separate module; only redirect behaviour is covered)
Generated PDF byte-level content correctness (only that the download is triggered and opens)
AI model quality/accuracy of generated summaries and PPS suggestions (only that generate/save/persist mechanics work)
Form Builder / dynamic form submissions creation (only the submission count + timeline display is in scope)

screens.name: Patient Detail Dashboard (Overview / Visits / Trends / Past Records)

roles_and_access: All three routes (/patients, /patients/:id, /patients/:id/edit) require an authenticated session (valid JWT in localStorage access_token) but no special permission — any logged-in user may view, create and edit patients and assessments. The only role-gated action is UHID regeneration: the Refresh icon next to the UHID chip and the backend POST /api/patients/:id/regenerate-uhid are admin-only (require_role('admin')). A non-admin must not see the regenerate icon and the endpoint must return 403 for non-admins. Unauthenticated/expired-token access: the axios client attaches the Bearer token; on a 401 it attempts a one-time refresh via the refresh_token, and if that fails it clears localStorage and hard-redirects to /login.

api_endpoints.purpose: List/search patients. Query: q, page, per_page (max 100), sort_by, sort_order, bsc_status, is_onco, geographic_cluster. Returns {patients,total,page,per_page,total_pages}.
Create patient. Validates PatientCreateSchema; ABHA-address duplicate check (409); returns 201 {patient}. 400 on validation error.
Get patient by UUID; records recent-access; 404 if not found.
Update patient (all-optional PatientUpdateSchema). 200 patient, 404 if not found, 400 on validation error.
Admin-only. Mint new UHID from current year/zone counter; old UHID kept in history. 400 if not Bangalore resident / no zone; 409 on collision; 403 non-admin.
Read-only peek at next UHID for (zone, hospital). 400 on missing/invalid zone or hospital.
Record standalone patient-level PPS (visit_id=NULL); syncs latest_pps_score + clinical_complexity. 400 if pps_score not 0-100; 404 if patient missing; 201 {pps,priority}.
Paginated form submissions for a patient. 404 if patient missing.
Recently accessed patients for current user. Query limit (max 50).
Advanced search with filters (gender, age range, city, state, has_abha, has_submissions, bsc_status, is_onco, geographic_cluster, date range, sort).
Check for existing patient by abha_address. Returns {duplicate_found, patient?}.
Patient timeline (creation + form submissions), newest first. 404 if patient missing.
Comprehensive cross-module history: Saranam visits+assessments, encounters, IPD admissions, dispensings, form submissions, with summary counts. Powers Past Records tab.
Point-in-polygon GBA zone detection from {lat,lng}. 400 if lat/lng missing; returns {zone} or null.
GBA zone boundary GeoJSON + colors for map overlay.
List diagnosis dropdown options (DB-backed with defaults).
Add a diagnosis option. 400 if blank; 409 if already exists; 201 with options.
Replace full diagnosis list. 400 if empty/non-array.
Remove a diagnosis option. 400 blank, 404 not found.
List referral partner options.
Add a referral partner. 409 if exists.
Replace full referral partner list.
Remove a referral partner. 404 not found.
Hospital master list (active only by default; include_inactive=1 for all).
Add hospital. Validates code (alnum 2-10), name required, prefix 5-20. 409 if code exists.
Replace catalog. code & homecare_prefix immutable for existing; at most one default; 422 on violation.
Hard-delete if zero references else soft-delete; force=1 forces soft. 409 if deleting the default.
Service health check (unauthenticated).

test_data_setup: At least 25 existing patients spanning >1 page (per_page is 20) with a mix of genders, ages, BSC/N-BSC, Onco/Non-Onco, all five zones (North/South/East/West/Central), some with submissions and some without.
At least one patient in each zone with is_bangalore_resident=true + a linked hospital so UHID preview/generation can be tested.
At least one non-Bangalore patient (is_bangalore_resident=false, no zone, no UHID) to verify UHID never assigned.
At least one patient with an existing ABHA address (e.g. 'ramesh.kumar@abdm') to trigger the duplicate-check path.
At least one patient already marked Deceased and one with care_status 'inactive' to verify status chips/badges.
At least one patient with a completed initial visit + recorded ESAS-R, PPS and vitals across multiple follow-up visits so Trends and Past Records render charts/timeline.
One admin user and one non-admin (e.g. nurse/doctor) user for permission tests on UHID regeneration.
Valid access_token + refresh_token in localStorage; ability to corrupt/expire the access_token to test 401 handling.
Hospital master list seeded with at least KMIO (default), KCGH and SWON.
Diagnosis options and referral partner options seeded (defaults exist if DB empty).

Realistic India test inputs: names (Ramesh Kumar, Lakshmi Devi, Mohammed Irfan), +91 10-digit phones (9876543210), Bangalore PINs (560004 South, 560064 North, 560001 Central), ABHA 14-digit IDs, DD/MM/YYYY DOBs.

steps: Leave category unselected, click Save
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Please select a patient category'; no PUT call made.

test_cases.title: Record a patient-level PPS score and verify derived priority
test_cases.preconditions: Patient open; no PPS recorded yet.
steps: In the PPS card click 'Record PPS'
Click the PPS 30% row, add a note, click Save PPS
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/patients/:id/pps returns 201; card shows '30%' and Derived Priority 'High' (0-40 High). clinical_complexity updates everywhere (header chip, edit screen). onSaved refreshes the patient.

test_cases.title: PPS-to-priority mapping is correct across bands
steps: Record PPS 80 and check derived priority
Record PPS 60 and check
Record PPS 40 and check
test_cases.expected_result: 80 -> Low (80-100), 60 -> Medium (50-70), 40 -> High (0-40). Each save updates the card and patient clinical_complexity.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - PPS Default by Priority
test_cases.title: PPS dialog pre-selects a row based on existing priority when no PPS exists
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with clinical_complexity set (e.g. high) but no PPS recorded.
steps: Open the Record PPS dialog and observe the pre-selected row and the info hint
test_cases.expected_result: The top of the priority band is pre-selected (high->40) and an info banner explains it was pre-selected from priority. The user can pick any other row before saving.

test_cases.title: Save and re-load Primary Caregiver and Decision Maker
steps: In Care Circle enter caregiver name/relationship/phone and decision maker name/designation/phone
Click Save, then refresh the page
test_cases.test_data: Caregiver: Ravi / Son / 9123456780; Decision Maker: Dr. Ashwini / Oncologist / 9988776655
test_cases.expected_result: PUT /api/patients/:id persists the six fields. Save button is disabled until a field changes (dirty) and shows 'Saved' afterward. Values persist on reload and prefill the Edit screen.

test_cases.title: Drop a red dot marker on the body map and save a note
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with an initial visit so the body map renders.
steps: Select the Dot tool, click a spot on the Front view
Type a finding e.g. 'Tender mass RUQ' and Save
test_cases.expected_result: A red dot + label appears; the annotation persists via PUT/save to doctor_assessment body_map_annotations (saveAssessment 'doctor'). Reloading shows the marker.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - Body Map Shapes & Edit
test_cases.title: Draw rectangle/ellipse, edit and delete a marker
steps: Select Rectangle, drag to draw an area, add text, Save
Click the marker label, edit text, Save
Click again and Delete
test_cases.expected_result: Rectangle/ellipse render in red; editing updates the label; deleting removes it. Each operation persists and survives reload. Empty note text disables Save.

test_cases.title: Clear AI suggestions and Clear entire body map confirm dialogs
test_cases.preconditions: Body map has both user notes and AI highlights.
steps: Click 'Clear AI suggestions' and confirm
Add notes again, click 'Clear entire body map' and confirm
test_cases.expected_result: Each shows a window.confirm; confirming removes AI-only (first) or both layers (second). Cancelling leaves markers intact. Buttons are disabled when there is nothing to clear.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - Body Map Visit Selector
test_cases.title: Body map 'View' selector shows historical visit highlights read-only
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with at least one follow-up summary containing body_locations.
steps: Open the body map 'View' dropdown
Select a follow-up visit entry
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting a visit renders that visit's AI highlights read-only (no editing tools); the caption notes 'read-only'. Selecting 'Baseline (editable)' restores edit mode.

test_cases.title: Generate, edit, save and download the AI patient summary
steps: Click 'Generate Patient Summary'
Edit the Nursing/Psychosocial/Physiotherapy blocks
Click Save, then Download PDF
test_cases.expected_result: Generate fills the three narrative blocks (deterministic demographics/scores unchanged); Save persists summary_blocks + body_locations; a 'Saved.' alert and 'Last saved <time>' show. Download PDF triggers a file download. Save is disabled when all blocks are empty.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - AI Summary Overwrite Guard
test_cases.title: Regenerating with unsaved edits prompts an overwrite confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: Summary generated and edited but not saved.
steps: Edit a block without saving
Click 'Generate Patient Summary' again
test_cases.expected_result: A dialog 'Regenerate and overwrite your edits?' appears; Cancel keeps the edits, 'Overwrite & Generate' replaces them with a fresh draft.

test_cases.title: Latest Patient Health + Past Records follow-up summaries render
steps: View 'Latest Patient Health' card
Expand 'Past Records' (Show all)
test_cases.expected_result: Latest card shows the newest follow-up summary text with visit number/date. Past Records lists all summaries newest-first with a count chip; expand/collapse works. When none exist, friendly placeholders show.

test_cases.title: Fill, save and reload Nursing Assessment (toggles, pain slider, devices)
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with an initial visit; Nursing accordion expanded.
steps: Set State=Conscious, ADL=Independent, Pain slider=6, tick Urinary Catheter
Enter wound/bowel/bladder text and Save
Collapse and reopen the accordion / reload
test_cases.expected_result: saveAssessment 'nursing' succeeds; accordion status chip flips to 'Saved'. Reloading restores all values including the pain score and device checkboxes.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - Nursing AI Summary Guard
test_cases.title: Nursing auto-generate summary requires a saved record first
test_cases.preconditions: Nursing form open but never saved.
steps: Click 'Generate from assessment' before saving
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Save the assessment first — the AI summary reads the saved record.' and the button is disabled until hasSavedRow is true.

test_cases.title: Fill ICD diagnosis rows + clinical history and save Doctor Assessment
steps: Add a diagnosis row (code C50.9, name 'Ca Breast Stage III', type Primary)
Fill chief complaints, HPI, systemic exam fields
Click Save Doctor's Assessment
test_cases.test_data: C50.9 / Ca Breast Stage III / Primary
test_cases.expected_result: saveAssessment 'doctor' stores a combined diagnosis string and exam fields; status chip flips to 'Saved'; reload restores data (diagnosis parsed back into a row).

test_cases.title: Set ESAS-R symptom sliders 0-10 and verify total + color coding
steps: Set Pain=8, Tiredness=5, Nausea=2, others 0; add an 'Other' symptom name+score
Observe the total and Save
test_cases.expected_result: Each slider is constrained to 0-10. Total = sum of all (incl. other) and is color-coded (<=30 green, <=60 yellow, else red). saveAssessment 'esas' stores total_score and all symptoms; reload restores.

test_cases.title: Select a PPS row in the baseline PPS form and save
steps: Click the 70% row (shows median survival)
Add a note and click Save PPS Score
test_cases.expected_result: Selected row highlights with a color band; the header shows 'PPS 70%' and '~145 days median survival'. saveAssessment 'pps' stores the full PPS dimensions; status chip becomes 'Saved'.

test_cases.title: Saving PPS form without selecting a score is blocked
test_cases.preconditions: Fresh PPS form, no priority default, no row selected.
steps: Without selecting a row, click Save PPS Score
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Please select a PPS score'; no save call.

test_cases.title: Smart PPS suggestion generates a score with reasoning
test_cases.preconditions: Initial visit with nursing/doctor/ESAS data saved.
steps: Click 'Suggest PPS Score'
Click 'Apply Score' and toggle 'Show reasoning'
test_cases.expected_result: A suggested score with a confidence badge and reasoning bullets appears; 'Apply Score' sets the table selection; reasoning expands/collapses. On failure an alert 'Failed to generate suggestion' shows.

test_cases.title: Complete Psychological Assessment incl. distress slider and Zarit
steps: Set patient mood/sleep, tick problem categories, set distress slider
Answer the 4 Zarit questions and Save
test_cases.expected_result: Distress slider color-codes; Zarit total + interpretation compute; saveAssessment 'psychological' stores values; status chip 'Saved'; reload restores.

test_cases.title: Complete and save Physiotherapy Assessment (pain VAS, ROM, MMT)
steps: Set pain VAS, pain area/nature, posture, ROM, MMT, balance, functional status, notes
Click Save
test_cases.expected_result: saveAssessment 'physiotherapy' succeeds; status chip 'Saved'; data persists and appears in Past Records.

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - Plan of Care / Prescription
test_cases.title: Build a prescription, add medications and save Plan of Care
test_cases.preconditions: Initial visit; Plan of Care accordion expanded.
steps: Add a medication (name/dosage/frequency/duration) in the Prescription Builder
Enter pharmacological + non-pharmacological notes, diagnosis text
Click Save Prescription then Save Plan of Care
test_cases.expected_result: saveAssessment 'care-plan' stores medications + notes; success alert shows; status chip 'Saved'. Data round-trips on reload.

test_cases.title: Download prescription PDF from Plan of Care
test_cases.preconditions: Prescription has at least one medication and doctor info filled.
steps: Fill doctor name/qualification/KMC number
Click the Download PDF action
test_cases.expected_result: A prescription PDF is generated with patient name, UHID/homecare code, medications and doctor details; failures show an alert with the error.

test_cases.title: UHID preview card shows probable UHID for an eligible patient
test_cases.preconditions: Bangalore patient with zone + linked hospital, no UHID yet, initial visit not complete.
steps: Scroll to the bottom of the Initial Assessment block before completing it
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/patients/uhid/preview fires and a 'UHID Preview' card shows the Homecare UHID Code and probable UHID with an 'estimate' note. The complete button reads 'Mark Complete and Assign UHID'.

test_cases.title: Missing zone/hospital shows warning instead of UHID preview
test_cases.preconditions: Bangalore patient with no zone or no linked hospital, no UHID.
steps: Open Overview and scroll to the complete button area
test_cases.expected_result: No preview card; a warning 'Set the patient's zone and linked hospital before completing the initial assessment to auto-generate a UHID.' shows. previewUhid is not requested (or returns 400 for invalid params).

test_cases.section: Overview Tab - Mark Initial Assessment Complete
test_cases.title: Marking initial assessment complete assigns a UHID
test_cases.preconditions: Eligible Bangalore patient with UHID preview (PAT-081).
steps: Click 'Mark Complete and Assign UHID'
Read the confirmation alert
test_cases.expected_result: Visit status -> completed; an alert 'Initial assessment completed. UHID <value> assigned.' shows; patient refreshes and the header/Clinical Status chips now display the real UHID. The block now shows 'Initial Assessment Completed'.

test_cases.title: Non-Bangalore patient never gets a UHID on completion
test_cases.preconditions: Non-Bangalore patient (is_bangalore_resident=false), initial visit not complete.
steps: Open Overview, confirm no UHID preview/card
Click 'Mark Initial Assessment as Complete'
test_cases.expected_result: No UHID preview card. On completion the visit is marked completed but no UHID is assigned (UHID chip stays '—'); the button label is the non-UHID variant.

test_cases.title: Overview shows info note when no initial visit exists
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with no initial visit record.
steps: Open the Overview tab
test_cases.expected_result: Instead of assessment accordions, an info alert 'No initial visit record found...' is shown; the body map section is hidden.

test_cases.title: Visits tab lists existing visits with count and status
steps: Open the Visits tab
test_cases.expected_result: Header shows 'N Visits'. Each visit shows visit number, type label, date, location, BP summary (if any) and a status chip (completed/in_progress/scheduled/cancelled). saranam listVisits is called.

test_cases.title: Visits tab empty state offers 'Record First Visit'
steps: Open the Visits tab
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'No visits recorded yet' with a 'Record First Visit' button that opens the New Visit dialog.

test_cases.title: Create a follow-up visit with vitals
steps: Click 'New Visit'
Type=Follow-Up, set date, Location=Home, enter vitals (PR 80, BP 120/80, SpO2 98)
Click Create Visit
test_cases.expected_result: saranam createVisit succeeds; dialog closes; the new visit appears at the top of the list with the vitals summary. Empty vitals are sent as null.

test_cases.title: Teleconsult requires provider and time
steps: Set Visit Type = Teleconsult (location switches to Video Call, time picker appears)
Leave provider unselected and click Schedule Teleconsult
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Please pick a provider for the teleconsult.' (and 'Please pick a time.' if time is blank). No visit/session created until both are set.

test_cases.title: Schedule a video teleconsult creates both a visit and a tele session
test_cases.preconditions: New Visit dialog; a provider exists.
steps: Type=Teleconsult, Location=Video Call, pick a provider, set a future time, toggle 'Record this call'
Click Schedule Teleconsult
test_cases.expected_result: createVisit then teleconsult scheduleSession are both called (channel=video, record_call=true, scheduled_at ISO from date+time). Info note about notifications is shown. The visit appears in the list.

test_cases.section: Visits Tab - Visit Type / Location Coupling
test_cases.title: Switching away from Teleconsult resets location to Home
test_cases.preconditions: New Visit dialog; Teleconsult selected with Video location.
steps: Switch Visit Type from Teleconsult back to Follow-Up
test_cases.expected_result: Location dropdown reverts to {Home} and value resets to 'home'; the time picker, provider select and record toggle disappear.

test_cases.title: Opening a visit loads the Follow-Up Sheet with saved data + baseline
test_cases.preconditions: A follow-up visit with previously saved data exists.
steps: Open the Visits tab and click a visit
Expand the 'Initial Assessment (Baseline)' read-only block
test_cases.expected_result: Visit, doctor and psychological assessments and care-plan load into the sheet. Baseline shows diagnosis/pain/ESAS/PPS/medications read-only. Header shows visit number, type label and full date.

test_cases.title: Edit vitals/notes and Save Follow-Up persists
steps: Enter chief complaints, HPI, vitals (incl. GRBS), follow-up advice, visit summary
Click Save Follow-Up
test_cases.expected_result: updateVisit + saveAssessment('doctor') (+ psychological if present) succeed; button shows 'Saved!' for ~3s; reload shows the saved data.

test_cases.title: Save & Mark Complete sets the visit to completed and returns to the list
steps: Click 'Save & Mark Complete'
test_cases.expected_result: The follow-up saves, then updateVisit sets status='completed', and the view returns to the visit list where the visit shows a green 'completed' chip.

test_cases.section: Visit Detail - Patient Outcome Deceased Validation
test_cases.title: Ticking 'Patient has passed away' requires a date of death
steps: Tick 'Patient has passed away', clear the auto-filled date
Click Save Follow-Up
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Please set the date of death before saving.'; save aborts. The date input rejects future dates (max=today).

test_cases.section: Visit Detail - Patient Outcome Others Remark
test_cases.title: Place of death 'Others' requires remarks
test_cases.preconditions: Visit detail; deceased ticked with a valid date.
steps: Set Place of death = Others, leave Remarks blank
Click Save Follow-Up
test_cases.expected_result: Alert 'Please describe the place of death in Remarks.'; save aborts until remarks are entered.

test_cases.section: Visit Detail - Mark Deceased from Visit
test_cases.title: Marking deceased from a visit updates the patient record
steps: Tick passed away, set date 2026-05-20, Place=Home
Click Save Follow-Up
Navigate back to the patient header
test_cases.expected_result: PUT /api/patients/:id sends is_deceased=true + date/place; the patient header now shows the Deceased chip with the date; the patient is removed from the scheduling pool (care_status auto-demoted).

test_cases.title: Un-ticking deceased reverts the patient to alive and clears death fields
test_cases.preconditions: A deceased patient's visit detail open.
steps: Untick 'Patient has passed away'
Click Save Follow-Up
test_cases.expected_result: PUT /api/patients/:id sends is_deceased=false and nulls date_of_death/place_of_death/remarks; header reverts to Alive status.

test_cases.title: Save and download a per-visit prescription
steps: In the Prescription block add a medication, set diagnosis text
Click Save (prescription), then Download PDF
test_cases.expected_result: saveAssessment('care-plan') for the visit succeeds (Saved state). Download PDF generates a prescription document; missing data fails with an alert, not a crash.

test_cases.title: Follow-up AI summary generate/save shown only for non-initial visits
steps: Click Generate in 'Follow-up Visit Summary', edit, click Save
Open an initial visit and confirm the card is absent
test_cases.expected_result: For follow-ups, generate fills the textarea + body map highlights; Save persists (saveFollowupSummary) and shows 'Last saved'. For initial visits the FollowupSummaryCard does not render.

test_cases.title: Trends tab renders Vitals, ESAS-R and PPS charts
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with vitals across visits + ESAS + PPS history.
steps: Open the Trends tab
Inspect the three chart sections
test_cases.expected_result: Three calls (saranam getPatientScores for esas/pps/vitals) load. Vitals chart shows source legend + tab selector; ESAS chart shows symptom toggles + total burden area; PPS chart shows bands and latest PPS detail cards.

test_cases.title: Switching vital tabs changes the plotted metric and Y-domain
steps: Click each vital tab: Blood Pressure, Pulse Rate, SpO2, Temperature, Resp. Rate, GRBS
test_cases.expected_result: BP plots systolic + diastolic; the others plot a single line. The Y-axis domain and normal-range band change per metric; baseline reference line appears where baseline data exists.

test_cases.title: ESAS symptom toggles show/hide individual lines + Show/Hide All
steps: Toggle off Pain, then Tiredness
Click 'Hide All' then 'Show All'
test_cases.expected_result: Each toggled symptom line disappears/reappears. 'Hide All'/'Show All' clears/restores all symptom lines.

test_cases.title: Change-from-baseline cards compute deltas and improve/deteriorate status
steps: Scroll to 'Change from Baseline (Initial Visit)'
test_cases.expected_result: Each vital card shows latest value, delta vs baseline with up/down icon, reference range, and improved/deteriorated/stable coloring based on proximity to the range center.

test_cases.title: Trends tab shows empty state when no assessment data exists
steps: Open the Trends tab
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'No assessment data recorded yet' with guidance text; no chart sections render.

test_cases.title: Past Records timeline loads cross-module events newest-first
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with visits, assessments, dispensings or forms.
steps: Open the Past Records tab
Expand a 'Home Visit' event
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/patients/:id/full-history loads. Timeline shows registration + visits + encounters + IPD + dispensing + forms, newest first. Expanding a home visit reveals vitals badges, assessment summaries and prescription.

test_cases.title: Type filter chips narrow the timeline
steps: Click 'Home Visits', then 'Medicines', then 'All'
test_cases.expected_result: Only chips with count>0 (plus All) render. Selecting a type filters events to that type; counts in each chip match the summary returned by the API.

test_cases.title: Past Records empty state when no history
test_cases.preconditions: Newly registered patient with no events beyond registration is unavailable; use a patient with zero events.
steps: Open Past Records for a patient with no recorded events
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'No records found' with guidance text; no timeline rendered.

test_cases.title: Saved visit/assessment data appears correctly in Past Records
test_cases.preconditions: Just saved a follow-up visit with vitals + ESAS + PPS (from PAT-093/074/073).
steps: Open Past Records and expand the corresponding home visit
test_cases.expected_result: The expanded event shows the exact vitals (BP/PR/SpO2/Temp/RR/GRBS), ESAS scores per symptom + total, PPS score and dimensions, and prescription medications that were saved.

test_cases.title: Edit screen prefills all fields from the patient record
test_cases.preconditions: A patient with full data exists.
steps: From the patient header click the Edit (pencil) icon, or open /patients/:id/edit
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/patients/:id loads and the form prefills name, DOB (normalised to YYYY-MM-DD), gender, phone (without +91), email, alternative phone+name, hospital UHID, care circle, address, diagnosis, referral, category, priority, care status, Bangalore resident + zone + linked hospital. UHID/homecare chips show read-only with explanatory note.

test_cases.title: Full Name is required on edit
steps: Clear Full Name and click Save Changes
test_cases.expected_result: The Full Name field is marked required; saving with it blank should be prevented or rejected by the backend with a visible error (no silent blank save).

test_cases.title: Phone fields strip non-digits, cap at 10, and store +91
steps: Type 'abc91234567890' into Phone Number
Save and re-open the edit screen
test_cases.expected_result: Input shows only 10 digits (9123456789); on save it is stored as +919123456789. Re-opening shows the 10 digits without the +91 prefix.

test_cases.title: Edit demographics and save successfully with redirect
steps: Change diagnosis, gender and add an alternative phone+relationship
Click Save Changes
test_cases.expected_result: PUT /api/patients/:id succeeds; a green 'Patient updated successfully!' alert shows; after ~0.8s it redirects to /patients/:id where changes are reflected.

test_cases.title: Editing Patient Category updates bsc_status + is_onco
steps: Change Patient Category to 'Non-BSC Onco' and save
test_cases.expected_result: PUT sends bsc_status=false,is_onco=true; the detail page chips show N-BSC + Onco afterwards.

test_cases.title: Toggling Bangalore Resident reveals/clears zone + hospital
test_cases.preconditions: Edit screen open; patient currently non-Bangalore.
steps: Turn on 'Bangalore Resident'
Set zone South and a linked hospital, save
Turn it off again and save
test_cases.expected_result: Turning on shows Bangalore Zone + Linked Hospital (defaults KMIO). Saving sends geographic_cluster + linked_hospital. Turning off clears both fields and the save omits them (or nulls them).

test_cases.title: Add a new hospital inline from the Edit screen
steps: Click + next to Linked Hospital, add code 'BGH' + name, click Add
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/patients/config/hospital-options adds the hospital and auto-selects it in Linked Hospital.

test_cases.title: Change care status between Active and Inactive (alive patient)
steps: Set Care Status = 'Alive & Inactive' and save
Reopen and set back to 'Alive & Active'
test_cases.expected_result: PUT sends care_status accordingly (only when not deceased). The detail header chip reflects 'Alive & Inactive' / 'Alive & Active'. Inactive patients drop out of the scheduling pool.

test_cases.section: Patient Edit - Mark Deceased from Edit
test_cases.title: Mark as Deceased from the Edit screen
steps: Click 'Mark as Deceased'
Set date + place in the dialog, confirm
test_cases.expected_result: MarkDeceasedDialog saves via PUT /api/patients/:id (is_deceased=true). The Patient Status section switches to the 'Marked as Deceased' read-only summary with an 'Edit Death Record' button.

test_cases.title: Cancel returns to detail without saving
steps: Make an edit then click Cancel (or Back to Patient)
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates back to /patients/:id; no PUT is sent and the change is discarded.

test_cases.title: Edit URL for a missing patient shows 'Patient not found'
steps: Open /patients/<non-existent-uuid>/edit
test_cases.expected_result: Loading resolves to a 'Patient not found' error state; no editable form is shown.

test_cases.title: Mark Deceased requires a date of death
test_cases.preconditions: Mark Deceased dialog open from header.
steps: Clear the date field
Observe the Confirm Death button and try to save
test_cases.expected_result: Confirm Death is disabled when date is blank; if forced, an error 'Date of death is required' shows. Date input caps at today (no future deaths).

test_cases.title: Place 'Others' requires remarks in the dialog
test_cases.preconditions: Mark Deceased dialog open with a valid date.
steps: Select Place = Others, leave Remarks blank, click Confirm Death
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Please describe the place of death in Remarks'; save blocked until remarks are entered.

test_cases.title: Re-opening for a deceased patient pre-fills and titles 'Edit Death Record'
steps: Click the flower icon in the header (tooltip 'Edit death record')
Observe pre-filled date/place/remarks and the dialog title/button
test_cases.expected_result: Dialog title 'Edit Death Record', button 'Update', and fields pre-filled with existing date/place/remarks. Saving updates the record.

test_cases.title: Marking deceased reflects on list cards and removes from scheduling
test_cases.preconditions: Alive patient appears in /patients list and the scheduling pool.
steps: Mark the patient deceased via the dialog
Return to /patients (grid + table) and check the scheduling pool/day map
test_cases.expected_result: The patient card/row shows a 'Deceased' badge; the detail header shows the Deceased chip; the patient no longer appears in the active scheduling pool (care_status auto-demoted to inactive by the backend).

test_cases.title: A newly created patient appears in list, search and selector
steps: After creation, view the /patients list
Search by the new patient's name
Open a flow using PatientSelector/PatientSearch and search for the patient
test_cases.expected_result: The new patient appears in the list (count incremented), is found by search, and shows up in the PatientSearch autocomplete (>=2 chars) and PatientSelector results.

test_cases.section: Data Integrity - PPS Sync Across Surfaces
test_cases.title: PPS recorded on Overview reflects on header, edit screen and Trends
steps: Record PPS 30 via the PPS card
Check the header Priority chip, the Edit screen Priority field, and the Trends PPS chart
test_cases.expected_result: Header chip shows Priority: High; Edit screen 'Patient Priority' shows high with helper text referencing the PPS %; Trends PPS chart adds the new data point.

test_cases.title: List per_page is capped at 100 server-side
steps: Call GET /api/patients?per_page=500
test_cases.expected_result: Response per_page is clamped to 100; total_pages computed accordingly; no error.

test_cases.title: Duplicate-check returns false for a brand-new ABHA address
steps: POST /api/patients/duplicate-check with a never-used abha_address
test_cases.expected_result: 200 with {"duplicate_found": false}; for an existing one it returns {"duplicate_found": true, "patient": {...}}.

test_cases.title: UHID preview rejects missing/invalid zone or hospital
steps: GET /api/patients/uhid/preview with no zone
GET with zone=Atlantis
GET with a valid zone but hospital=ZZZ
test_cases.expected_result: Missing zone -> 400 missing_zone; invalid zone -> 400 invalid_zone (lists valid zones); invalid hospital -> 400 invalid_hospital.

steps: POST /api/patients/:id/pps with pps_score=120
POST with pps_score='abc'
POST with pps_score=null
test_cases.expected_result: 120 -> 400 'pps_score must be 0-100'; 'abc' -> 400 'pps_score must be an integer 0-100'; null -> 400. A valid 0-100 returns 201 with pps + priority.

test_cases.title: POST PPS for a non-existent patient returns 404
steps: POST /api/patients/<missing-uuid>/pps with pps_score=50
test_cases.expected_result: 404 'Patient not found'.

test_cases.title: Zone detect requires lat and lng
steps: POST /api/patients/zones/detect with empty body
POST with valid Bangalore coords
test_cases.expected_result: Empty -> 400 'lat and lng are required'. Valid coords -> 200 {zone: 'Central'|...} or null if outside all GBA corporations.

test_cases.title: Diagnosis options config enforces duplicate/not-found rules
steps: POST diagnosis-options with an existing option
DELETE diagnosis-options for an option not in the list
PUT diagnosis-options with an empty array
test_cases.expected_result: Existing -> 409 'Option already exists'; missing -> 404 'Option not found'; empty array -> 400 'options must be a non-empty array'.

test_cases.title: Hospital code and homecare_prefix are immutable on update
steps: PUT hospital-options changing KMIO's homecare_prefix
PUT with two entries flagged is_default=true
PUT with duplicate codes
test_cases.test_data: changed prefix; two defaults; duplicate codes
test_cases.expected_result: Changing prefix -> 422 'homecare_prefix is immutable...'; two defaults -> 422 'only one hospital may have is_default=true'; duplicate codes -> 422 'duplicate codes in payload'.

test_cases.title: Hospital delete soft-deletes when referenced, hard-deletes when not
test_cases.preconditions: API access; one referenced hospital and one unused hospital; one is default.
steps: DELETE an unused, non-default hospital
DELETE a hospital referenced by a patient
DELETE the current default hospital
test_cases.test_data: unused code; referenced code; default code
test_cases.expected_result: Unused -> 200 mode 'hard'. Referenced -> 200 mode 'soft' with counts. Default -> 409 'cannot_delete_default'.

test_cases.title: All patient requests include the Bearer token
steps: Open /patients and inspect the request headers for GET /api/patients
test_cases.expected_result: Every /api/patients request carries 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' from localStorage.

test_cases.title: Expired access token triggers a one-time refresh and retry
steps: Expire the access_token in localStorage
Trigger a patient request (e.g. reload /patients)
test_cases.expected_result: The 401 triggers POST /api/auth/refresh; on success the access_token is replaced and the original request is retried transparently and succeeds.

test_cases.title: Failed refresh clears storage and redirects to /login
steps: Invalidate both tokens
Trigger a patient request
test_cases.expected_result: After the failed refresh, access_token/refresh_token/user are removed from localStorage and the app hard-redirects to /login.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated access to patient routes redirects to login
steps: Open /patients, then /patients/:id, then /patients/:id/edit directly
test_cases.expected_result: Each route requires authentication; an unauthenticated user is redirected to /login and cannot view patient data.

test_cases.title: Very long and special-character search strings are handled safely
steps: Search with a 300-char string and with characters like <script>, %, ', "
Submit
test_cases.expected_result: No XSS executes; the app returns 0 results or matching results without errors; the query is sent URL-encoded as q.

test_cases.title: Registration handles very long names and special characters
steps: Enter a 200-char first name, a name with apostrophe (D'Souza) and accented chars
Fill required fields and create
test_cases.expected_result: The name is accepted (auto-capitalised first letter); special characters are preserved; either created successfully or a clear backend validation error — no crash.

test_cases.title: Country field is locked to India
steps: Attempt to edit the Country field
test_cases.expected_result: Country is disabled and fixed to 'India'.

test_cases.section: Patient Detail - Care Circle in AI Summary
test_cases.title: Care circle data feeds the AI summary Basic Patient Details
steps: Open the AI Patient Summary card and read 'Primary Caregiver' and 'Phone Number'
test_cases.expected_result: Basic Patient Details shows the saved primary caregiver (name + relationship + phone) and falls back to caregiver/alternative phone when no direct phone exists.

test_cases.title: 'Back to Patients' returns to the list
steps: Click 'Back to Patients'
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to /patients.

test_cases.title: Cannot save a PPS without selecting a row in the universal card
test_cases.preconditions: Patient with no priority/PPS; PPS card dialog open.
steps: Open Record PPS where no default applies, do not click a row, click Save PPS
test_cases.expected_result: Save is disabled / alerts 'Please select a PPS score'; no POST is sent.
